items.name: AgentKit by Scalekit
items.tagline: MCP gateway for production agents that acts on your behalf
items.description: Let your agents use 30,000+ tools across 600+ apps, from Salesforce to GitHub, through one MCP gateway. AgentKit handles auth and integrations, so every action runs as the user who asked, within the scopes they granted. Give each agent only the tools its job needs with Virtual MCP Servers. Add internal APIs as custom connectors. Use Triggers to start an agent the moment an email lands. Built for developers taking agents to production: every call is logged. Free tier: 10,000 tool calls a month.

items.name: Teamily AI
items.tagline: Your personal agent, agent teams & people in one messenger
items.description: The human-agent platform where people and always-on agents get work done together in one unified, context-aware space. Unlike single-user personal agents, Teamily AI enables multi-user, multi-agent teamwork. Built on an AI-native messenger, it connects people, agents, docs, meetings, calls, workflows, and business systems to automate office work and customer service. Agents become real teammates with persistent memory, proactive intelligence, and continuous self-improvement. Free to get started.

items.name: Testifly
items.tagline: Autonomous AI QA. Zero prompting. Zero maintenance.
items.description: CTOs and founders with small teams and no time or resources to test and maintain. Connect your web app and Testifly does the rest. Discovers flows, writes tests, self-heals, explains failures with video. Zero prompting. Zero maintenance. 30-day free trial.

items.name: Synter Canvas
items.tagline: Your AI agent runs ads across 30+ ad platforms
items.description: Your AI agent builds, launches and optimizes campaigns across 30+ ad platforms, with safety gates and guardrails on every change. $0.25 per verified write, 0% of ad spend.

items.name: Videco
items.tagline: Turn every video into a content campaign with AI
items.description: Videco is an AI content studio and video hosting workspace for marketing teams. Find standout moments in demos and webinars, create branded short-form clips, and host, embed, and measure video in one place.

items.name: Calendarly
items.tagline: Your calendar and tasks, right on your iPhone Lock Screen
items.description: Calendarly draws your calendar, reminders, Todoist tasks, notes and countdowns onto the iPhone Lock Screen wallpaper, and redraws it automatically through a Shortcuts automation.

items.name: MachineMail
items.tagline: Real inboxes for AI agents, with trust built in
items.description: Give your AI agents real inboxes to receive and send emails. Connect them over MCP or API, use your own domain, and get a trust report on every inbound message. Free includes 3,000 messages/month; paid plans start at $9/month.

items.name: LifeVal
items.tagline: OpenAI's benchmark for everyday life tasks with AI
items.description: LifeVal is OpenAI's new eval for the everyday tasks people most want help with, like finding childcare, budgeting, ordering groceries and government services. OpenAI says it used LifeVal for a year to push ChatGPT toward real agent work.

items.name: Hookdeck Inspect
items.tagline: Free webhook tester for you and your agent
items.description: Test and debug webhooks with Hookdeck Inspect. Get a live URL you and your agent can use, plus mock webhooks for 500+ providers. It's free, no account or setup required.

items.name: People Search by Context.dev
items.tagline: People Search API: Find People by Role, Company & Location
items.description: Describe the people you need in plain English. Get up to 10 profiles per call with role, employer, location, experience, skills, and schools.

items.name: Wavefunction
items.tagline: A minimal, open-source coding agent for your Mac
items.description: Coding agents keep turning into super apps. Wavefunction goes the other way: a minimal desktop app built for coding. Keep chatting while it works on several tasks in parallel. Use your ChatGPT subscription, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter or a local model. Computer use runs on its own desktop, not yours. Free and open source.

items.name: Prism
items.tagline: Cursor for hardware engineering
items.description: Prism is the AI platform for hardware engineering. CAD, physics solvers, 3D viewers, coding, and reporting together in one place, all driven by agents. Go from ideas to validated design effortlessly. Free to try on Windows, Mac and Linux.

items.name: PowerShips
items.tagline: Where battleships meets powers!
items.description: Battleships with classes. Pick a class with an active ability and a passive, place your fleet and play a friend from a link or find an opponent online. Free, no sign-up.

items.name: Flockbay
items.tagline: Free AI game maker built on Godot
items.description: Flockbay is a free AI game maker built on Godot: an agent in the official Godot editor that writes GDScript and scenes, then playtests them. It runs the game, sends input events, reads the debugger and captures the viewport. Your game stays a plain Godot 4 project on disk. Start on free hosted AI, or bring your own Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, API key or MCP agent, or a local model on your GPU (Windows). Paid plans add Steam page drafts, trailers and devlogs. Godot 4.6+ on Windows, macOS, Linux.

items.name: nana
items.tagline: One terminal for every coding agent, on Windows
items.description: Nana is a native terminal multiplexer for Windows. Run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and more side by side, each on its own git worktree. See who is working, waiting or done, review diffs, and keep agents running after you close the app. Free beta.

items.name: Infino AI
items.tagline: Search, vectors and SQL over one Parquet copy, for agents
items.description: Infino is an open-source retrieval engine for AI agents. It keeps one copy of your data as Parquet on S3 or local disk, with BM25 and vector indexes inside the files. Agents run keyword, vector, hybrid and SQL search on it. Apache-2.0. Infino Cloud is generally available, with a free tier.

items.name: BRCKS Chat
items.tagline: The chat app for building sites. Nothing gets lost.
items.description: Every job gets its own chat for crews, subs and clients, with snags, bookings, video meetings and a client portal built in. Photos become snags, messages become a record. Subs and clients are free. Built by builders, for UK sites.

items.name: Brink
items.tagline: Turn your MacBook trackpad's edges into controls
items.description: Brink is a free macOS menu bar app that turns your trackpad's edges into controls. Slide the right edge for volume, the left for brightness, the top for keyboard light. Swipe the bottom to skip, double-tap the corner to mute. Native HUD, haptic ticks.

items.name: kwant
items.tagline: AI bots that check each other's work before saying "done"
items.description: Open-source AI team for your Mac, Linux or VPS. Hire bots from 27 roles; each message goes to the bot that fits, and you see why. Bots split work into cards, hand off and test each other, and a task turns Verified only when kwant checks it. Web facts come with links that open at the exact quote. Bots earn autonomy in Flight School, but payments always ask, and you choose which sites each bot may open. Runs on the Claude, Codex or Grok you already pay for.

items.name: IQ
items.tagline: The dashboard for your team's AI use
items.description: See usage, spend and every request in one place. Give each app or teammate its own key and limits. On Team, add budgets, alerts and an audit log. Built-in routing helps keep cost down. Plus IQ Code, our plugin for Claude Code. Free to start.
